item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Neon City on the Beat

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.

item.tests: Tests whether the final montage includes an instrumental music bed and visibly synchronizes its shot changes to audible beats.

answer_sheet.Required imagery: Neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections in a city at night.
answer_sheet.Music source and style: Create an original upbeat electronic instrumental bed; the specific tempo and instruments are your call.
answer_sheet.Editing: Cut between the city shots on the music's beat.
answer_sheet.Voice and text: No talking, singing or added text. Incidental signage is fine.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second landscape video is delivered with music embedded, not just separate video and audio files.
The montage visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections in a nighttime city setting.
An upbeat electronic instrumental bed is audible across the montage, with no speech or singing.
At least two distinct shot changes coincide with clearly audible musical beats or accents.
There are no added titles, captions or subtitles.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second cinematic widescreen night-city montage with synchronized original instrumental music. Photorealistic neon-lit city after rainfall, electric cyan and magenta with warm amber accents, rich blacks, beautiful wet reflections. AUDIO: compose an ORIGINAL upbeat electronic instrumental music bed at 120 BPM, punchy dance kick, crisp hi-hats, buoyant synth bass and bright melodic synth arpeggios. No speech, no talking, no singing, no vocal samples. Picture edits land precisely on musical downbeats at 0, 2, 4, 6 and 8 seconds. SHOT PLAN: 0-2 seconds close tracking shot of glowing neon signs with abstract non-letter shapes and bokeh above a bustling night street; 2-4 seconds dynamic lateral shot of a passing elevated commuter train, illuminated windows streaking against neon buildings; 4-6 seconds low ground-level tracking close-up of vivid neon reflections shimmering in wet asphalt and puddles; 6-8 seconds wide view of the passing train crossing the neon city with wet foreground reflections; 8-10 seconds gorgeous low-angle wet street reflection shot, subtle forward camera glide, finishing cleanly on the final musical accent. Hard cuts on the beat, not dissolves, coherent nighttime palette across all shots. Show all three motifs clearly: neon signs, passing train, wet street reflections. Neon signage must be abstract luminous symbols without readable words. No added text, captions, titles, logos or watermarks. Music is the soundtrack; no dialogue.
